title: 지방재정업무 처리를 위한 정보시스템의 관리ㆍ운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 지방재정업무 처리를 위한 정보시스템의 관리ㆍ운영에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the management and operation of an information system that processes overall affairs relating to local government finance pursuant to Article 96-2 (1) of the Local Finance Act.
